strongest_angle: The Mecca Clock Tower Museum achieved two Guinness World Records by establishing the highest museum in a building and the highest outdoor observation deck at 426.875 metres above ground in Saudi Arabia.

key_facts.fact: The Clock Tower Museum stands at 426.875 metres above ground in Makkah, Saudi Arabia, achieving a Guinness World Record for the highest museum in a building.

The Royal Commission for Makkah City and Holy Sites achieved two new global milestones with Guinness World Records for the world's highest museum in a building and the highest outdoor observation deck.
The Clock Tower Museum, situated 426.875 metres above ground, set a new Guinness World Record recognised in Mecca on November 17, 2026.

The Center for Cosmos Sciences, Crescent Observation, and the Makkah Clock received two Guinness World Records certificates for the highest museum inside a building and the highest outdoor observation deck.

named_entities.name: Royal Commission for Makkah City and Holy Sites
